current_answer: Fourteen listed ambassador routes have issuer-linked ways to apply and no published passed deadline: Hedera, Cyfrin, Soneium, Aster, Elk, Nomis, Torium, Nexo, Oasis Sentinels, Fiber, Bybit Africa Campus, HeLa, Cronos and Zerion. Cronos links an application form and describes five contribution tracks, but its official documentation uses unexplained “Ult” wording and the hosted form could not be inspected. Zerion says it reviews applications on a rolling basis and makes decisions quarterly; it states no ambassador salary. Pendulum remains Discord enrollment rather than a published application review; Wager Predict remains unconfirmed because its issuer post has incomplete reward and region terms. Bitget’s Trading Builder campaign remains open through 30 Sep; MetaMask is not confirmed, Solana and SideShift are closed, and PIVX is referral-only.

catalogue_card.question: Two formal routes added. Their terms are the story.
catalogue_card.text: Cronos and Zerion link official application forms, but neither offers a decision-ready pay deal. Cronos leaves form state, XP value and data steps unclear; Zerion has rolling review, quarterly decisions and no ambassador salary.

summary: Cronos links an official Season 3 ambassador form for contribution tracks including content, localization, education, campaigns and community work; salary, hours, XP value and current hosted-form state are not published.

Zerion links a rolling application for community builders, content creators and developers and says it decides once a quarter. It states no ambassador salary; work and reward conditions are not published.
Crypto.com’s ambassador privacy notice says selected ambassadors may later need identity documentation, including a photo and passport details. Read each stage before sharing data.
Pendulum remains Discord enrollment, and Wager Predict remains held out for incomplete issuer terms. Bitget’s Trading Builder campaign has a 30 Sep 2026 deadline.
uncertainty: An issuer-linked route does not prove a hosted form will accept a submission or that an applicant will be selected.
Cronos and Zerion link issuer-approved hosted forms, but their fields and current acceptance messages were not accessible in this check; Cronos documentation also uses unexplained “Ult” wording.
Zerion does not publish duties or reward conditions. Cronos does not publish expected hours, XP value, salary terms or individual payment conditions.
Aster’s latest substantive issuer check is 14 Sep 2026 because its announcement did not render in later checks.
Most listed routes do not publish decision-ready cash terms, hours, full selection rules or independent participant reports.
